metadata.title: Decision Intelligence Resource Hub - Sample Data
metadata.description: Comprehensive catalog of 40+ Decision Intelligence resources across 8 industries including decision models, ML models, rule models, task models, policies, dashboards, prompts, services, data models, optimization models, and rules

resource.name: string (required) - Display name of the resource
resource.type: string (required) - Resource type from resourceTypes list
resource.tasks: array of strings (required) - List of tasks/capabilities
resource.kpis: array of strings (optional) - Key performance indicators
resource.prompt: string (optional) - Prompt text for Decision Assistant Prompts
resource.components: array of strings (optional) - Related component IDs

resources.name: Credit Risk Assessment Decision Model
resources.description: Comprehensive decision model for evaluating credit applications with multi-tier risk scoring, automated approval thresholds, and regulatory compliance checks. Includes income verification, credit history analysis, and debt-to-income calculations.
resources.businessGoals: Automate credit decisions while maintaining risk standards and regulatory compliance

resources.name: Mortgage Loan Origination Rules
resources.description: Complete rule set for mortgage loan processing including property valuation, borrower qualification, and loan-to-value ratio calculations. Supports conventional, FHA, and VA loan types with automated document verification.
resources.businessGoals: Streamline mortgage origination while ensuring regulatory compliance and risk management

resources.name: Real-time Fraud Detection ML Model
resources.description: Integrated machine learning model for detecting fraudulent transactions in real-time using behavioral analysis, transaction patterns, and risk scoring. Provides decision services with fraud probability scores and recommended actions.
resources.businessGoals: Protect customers and institution from fraudulent activities while minimizing transaction friction

resources.name: Banking Compliance Policy Framework
resources.description: Comprehensive policy framework covering AML, KYC, GDPR, and Basel III requirements. Includes automated monitoring rules, reporting templates, and audit trail management for financial institutions.
resources.businessGoals: Ensure comprehensive regulatory compliance while reducing manual oversight burden

resources.name: Credit Risk Decision Model Generation Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for generating a comprehensive credit risk decision model that evaluates loan applications using multiple risk factors including credit score, income verification, and debt-to-income ratios.
resources.businessGoals: Accelerate decision model creation for consistent and accurate credit risk evaluation
resources.prompt: Create a decision model for credit risk assessment that evaluates loan applications based on applicant credit score (minimum 650), annual income (minimum 3x loan amount), debt-to-income ratio (maximum 45%), employment history (minimum 2 years), and collateral value (minimum 120% of loan amount). Include automatic approval for low-risk applications and escalation rules for edge cases. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for specific lending criteria and regulatory requirements.

resources.name: Predictive Maintenance Decision Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating a decision model that determines optimal maintenance schedules based on equipment condition, usage patterns, and failure risk.
resources.businessGoals: Optimize maintenance operations through predictive analytics and intelligent scheduling
resources.prompt: Build a predictive maintenance decision model using sensor data (vibration, temperature, pressure, oil analysis), equipment age and usage hours, maintenance history, and failure patterns. Create decision rules: Schedule maintenance when failure probability exceeds 20%, prioritize critical equipment (production impact >$10K/hour), consider maintenance resource availability, and balance preventive maintenance costs against downtime risks. Include seasonal adjustments and production schedule integration. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for safety protocols and maintenance standards.

resources.name: Insurance Claims Approval Decision Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for generating a decision model that automates insurance claims approval based on policy coverage, damage assessment, and risk factors.
resources.businessGoals: Streamline claims processing while maintaining accuracy and fraud prevention
resources.prompt: Create a decision model for insurance claims approval that evaluates claim amount, policy coverage limits, deductibles, claim history, damage assessment photos, and fraud risk indicators. Set approval thresholds: auto-approve claims under $5,000 with clear liability and documentation, require supervisor review for claims $5,000-$25,000, and escalate to adjusters for claims over $25,000 or with fraud indicators. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for coverage definitions and approval authority levels.

resources.name: Fraud Detection ML Model Integration Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for integrating a machine learning fraud detection model into decision services to automatically score and flag suspicious transactions in real-time.
resources.businessGoals: Integrate ML fraud detection into decision services for real-time transaction protection
resources.prompt: Configure an ML model integration for fraud detection that calls a pre-trained fraud scoring model with transaction data (amount, merchant, location, time, customer ID) and returns a fraud probability score (0-100). Set decision thresholds: auto-approve transactions with scores <20, require additional verification for scores 20-70, and block transactions with scores >70. Include fallback rules when the ML service is unavailable, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for fraud handling procedures and customer notification requirements.

resources.name: Customer Churn Prediction ML Integration Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for integrating a customer churn prediction ML model into decision services to identify at-risk customers and trigger retention campaigns.
resources.businessGoals: Proactively identify and retain at-risk customers through ML-powered insights
resources.prompt: Configure an ML model integration for customer churn prediction that scores customers (0-100 churn probability) using transaction history, engagement metrics, and demographic data. Set action thresholds: low risk (0-30) for standard communications, medium risk (31-70) for personalized offers, and high risk (71-100) for priority retention calls. Include decision logic for campaign timing, offer selection based on customer value, and exclusion rules for recent service issues. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for customer contact preferences and retention budget guidelines.

resources.name: Medical Risk Assessment ML Integration Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for integrating clinical risk prediction models into healthcare decision services to support patient care and resource allocation decisions.
resources.businessGoals: Improve patient outcomes through ML-powered clinical risk assessment and care planning
resources.prompt: Configure ML model integration for clinical risk assessment that predicts patient outcomes (readmission risk, length of stay, complications) using electronic health records, vital signs, and lab results. Set care pathways: low risk patients for standard discharge, moderate risk for enhanced monitoring, and high risk for extended care or intensive case management. Include decision rules for resource allocation, specialist referrals, and care team notifications. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for clinical protocols, privacy requirements, and care quality standards.

resources.name: Customer Onboarding Task Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating an automated task model that orchestrates the complete customer onboarding process from initial application to account activation.
resources.businessGoals: Streamline customer onboarding through intelligent task automation and orchestration
resources.prompt: Design a task automation model for customer onboarding that includes: (1) Document collection and verification, (2) Identity verification using government ID and biometric matching, (3) Credit check and risk assessment, (4) Account type recommendation based on customer profile, (5) Initial deposit processing, (6) Product enrollment (debit card, online banking, mobile app), (7) Welcome communication with account details, and (8) Follow-up satisfaction survey. Include decision points for manual review when verification confidence is below 95%. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for onboarding procedures and compliance requirements.

resources.name: Invoice Processing Task Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating an automated task model that handles end-to-end invoice processing from receipt to payment authorization.
resources.businessGoals: Automate invoice processing to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy
resources.prompt: Create a task automation model for invoice processing that includes: (1) OCR extraction of invoice data, (2) Vendor validation against approved supplier list, (3) Purchase order matching and three-way verification, (4) Tax calculation and compliance checking, (5) Approval routing based on amount and authority levels, (6) Exception handling for mismatches or missing data, (7) Payment scheduling and authorization, and (8) Audit trail documentation. Include escalation paths for manual review when confidence scores are below 90%. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for procurement policies and approval hierarchies.

resources.name: Service Request Task Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating a task automation model that handles customer service requests from initial triage through resolution.
resources.businessGoals: Improve customer service efficiency through intelligent request automation
resources.prompt: Design a task automation model for service requests that includes: (1) Initial request categorization and priority assignment, (2) Customer account validation and service history review, (3) Automated troubleshooting for common issues, (4) Service technician scheduling for field visits, (5) Parts ordering and inventory management, (6) Progress updates and customer communication, (7) Resolution verification and customer confirmation, and (8) Follow-up satisfaction survey. Include escalation to human agents for complex issues or customer dissatisfaction. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for service level agreements and escalation procedures.

resources.name: Claims Processing Rule Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for generating business rules that automate insurance claims processing decisions based on policy coverage, claim type, and damage assessment.
resources.businessGoals: Automate routine claims processing while ensuring accuracy and compliance
resources.prompt: Generate business rules for auto insurance claims processing: Automatically approve claims under $5,000 with clear liability, photo evidence, and no injury. Require adjuster review for claims over $15,000, total loss scenarios, or injury claims. Check policy coverage limits, deductibles, and exclusions. Validate repair estimates against market rates (±15% tolerance). Flag potential fraud indicators like multiple recent claims, late reporting (>72 hours), or inconsistent damage patterns. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for specific coverage terms, deductible structures, and approval authority levels.

resources.name: Smart Grid Load Balancing Rule Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for generating rules that automatically balance electrical grid load based on demand patterns, renewable generation, and system constraints.
resources.businessGoals: Maintain grid stability while maximizing renewable energy utilization
resources.prompt: Generate smart grid load balancing rules: Prioritize renewable energy sources when available, activate demand response programs when load exceeds 85% capacity, coordinate with energy storage systems for peak shaving, implement rolling blackout protocols only as last resort, and maintain frequency within ±0.1 Hz. Include weather-based predictions for solar/wind generation, time-of-use pricing signals, and emergency response procedures for equipment failures. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for grid reliability standards and emergency protocols.

resources.name: Tax Calculation Rule Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for generating comprehensive tax calculation rules supporting multiple jurisdictions, tax types, and exemptions for retail transactions.
resources.businessGoals: Ensure accurate tax calculations across all jurisdictions while maintaining compliance
resources.prompt: Create tax calculation rules that handle: (1) State and local sales tax rates by zip code, (2) Product-specific tax categories and exemptions, (3) Customer tax exemption certificates and validation, (4) Use tax calculations for out-of-state purchases, (5) Digital goods taxation based on customer location, (6) Special tax holidays and temporary rate changes, (7) International VAT calculations for global customers, and (8) Audit trail documentation for all calculations. Include fallback to manual review for complex scenarios. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for tax authority requirements and exemption criteria.

resources.name: Patient Risk Stratification Data Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for designing a comprehensive data model that integrates patient information for clinical risk assessment and care planning.
resources.businessGoals: Enable comprehensive patient risk assessment through integrated clinical data
resources.prompt: Design a patient risk stratification data model integrating: demographics (age, gender, socioeconomic factors), medical history (chronic conditions, previous admissions, surgeries), current medications and allergies, vital signs and lab results, social determinants (housing, transportation, social support), lifestyle factors (smoking, alcohol, exercise), and healthcare utilization patterns. Structure data to support risk scoring algorithms, care gap identification, and predictive analytics for readmission risk, disease progression, and resource needs. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for data privacy requirements and clinical standards.

resources.name: Customer 360 Data Model Design Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating a comprehensive customer data model that integrates all customer touchpoints and interactions for personalized experiences.
resources.businessGoals: Create unified customer profiles for enhanced personalization and decision making
resources.prompt: Design a customer 360 data model that consolidates: personal demographics and preferences, account information and transaction history, digital interactions across all channels, customer service interactions and satisfaction scores, product usage patterns and engagement metrics, external data sources (credit bureaus, social media), life events and milestones, and real-time behavioral indicators. Structure for real-time access and analytics while maintaining data lineage and quality. Include consent management and privacy controls. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for data governance and privacy requirements.

resources.name: Supply Chain Visibility Data Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for designing a data model that provides end-to-end supply chain visibility for tracking, analytics, and optimization.
resources.businessGoals: Enable supply chain optimization through comprehensive data integration and analytics
resources.prompt: Create a supply chain data model integrating: supplier information and performance metrics, purchase orders and contracts, inventory levels across all locations, production schedules and capacity data, logistics and transportation tracking, quality control and inspection results, demand forecasts and sales data, external factors (weather, geopolitical events), and cost analysis across all activities. Design for real-time updates and predictive analytics capabilities. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for supplier data sharing agreements and quality standards.

resources.name: Dynamic Pricing Optimization Model Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating an optimization model that determines optimal pricing strategies based on demand, competition, and inventory levels.
resources.businessGoals: Maximize revenue and profitability through intelligent dynamic pricing
resources.prompt: Create an optimization model for dynamic pricing that maximizes revenue while maintaining competitive position. Consider: demand elasticity (price sensitivity by product category), competitor pricing (stay within ±5% for key items), inventory levels (increase discounts for overstock, premium pricing for scarce items), seasonality patterns, customer segment willingness to pay, and margin constraints (minimum 20% gross margin). Update prices hourly for high-velocity items, daily for standard products. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for pricing guidelines and competitive positioning requirements.

resources.name: Resource Allocation Optimization Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating an optimization model that allocates limited resources across multiple projects or departments to maximize overall value.
resources.businessGoals: Optimize resource allocation to maximize public value and service delivery
resources.prompt: Design a resource allocation optimization model that considers: available budget constraints by department and time period, project priorities and strategic importance scores, resource requirements (personnel, equipment, facilities), expected outcomes and impact metrics, dependencies between projects and shared resources, risk factors and mitigation strategies, and stakeholder requirements. Optimize for maximum public value while maintaining service levels and compliance requirements. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for budget guidelines and strategic priorities.

resources.name: Real-time Credit Scoring Service Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating a decision service that provides real-time credit scoring for loan applications using integrated models and rules.
resources.businessGoals: Provide fast, reliable credit decisions through integrated decision services
resources.prompt: Create a decision service for real-time credit scoring that: (1) Accepts loan application data via API, (2) Calls ML fraud detection models for risk assessment, (3) Applies credit decision rules for approval/denial logic, (4) Integrates with external credit bureaus for score validation, (5) Calculates loan terms and interest rates, (6) Generates decision explanations for transparency, (7) Logs all decisions for audit and monitoring, and (8) Provides fallback responses during system outages. Include rate limiting and security controls. Reference existing models: credit-risk-model-001, fraud-detection-ml-002, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for lending criteria and regulatory requirements.

resources.name: Dynamic Pricing Decision Service Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating a decision service that provides real-time pricing recommendations based on market conditions and business rules.
resources.businessGoals: Enable real-time pricing optimization through intelligent decision services
resources.prompt: Build a pricing decision service that: (1) Receives product and customer context via API, (2) Analyzes competitor pricing from market data feeds, (3) Evaluates inventory levels and demand patterns, (4) Applies pricing optimization models for maximum revenue, (5) Checks business rules for margin constraints and promotional policies, (6) Returns optimal price with confidence scores, (7) Tracks pricing performance and customer response, and (8) Supports A/B testing for pricing strategies. Include caching for high-volume requests. Reference existing models: demand-forecasting-ml-001, pricing-optimization-model-001, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for pricing policies and competitive guidelines.

resources.name: Claims Processing Decision Automation Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating an end-to-end decision automation that handles insurance claims from submission to settlement.
resources.businessGoals: Automate claims processing to improve efficiency and customer experience
resources.prompt: Create a decision automation for claims processing that orchestrates: (1) Claim intake and data extraction from forms/photos, (2) Policy validation using policy service APIs, (3) Fraud detection scoring using ML models, (4) Damage assessment using image analysis services, (5) Settlement calculation using business rules, (6) Approval workflow based on amount and complexity, (7) Payment processing and customer notification, and (8) Quality review sampling for continuous improvement. Include exception handling and escalation paths. Reference existing services: policy-validation-service-001, fraud-detection-ml-001, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for claims handling procedures and settlement authority.

resources.name: Loan Origination Decision Automation Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating an automated loan origination process from application to funding decision with integrated compliance checks.
resources.businessGoals: Streamline loan origination while maintaining compliance and risk controls
resources.prompt: Design a loan origination automation that coordinates: (1) Application data collection and validation, (2) Identity verification using document analysis services, (3) Income verification through bank statement analysis, (4) Credit score retrieval and risk assessment, (5) Property appraisal ordering and review, (6) Underwriting decision using decision models, (7) Loan pricing and terms calculation, (8) Document generation and e-signature workflow, and (9) Funding and closing coordination. Include regulatory compliance checks at each step. Reference existing services: identity-verification-service-001, credit-scoring-service-001, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for underwriting guidelines and compliance requirements.

resources.name: Decision Performance Dashboard Creation Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating a comprehensive dashboard that monitors the performance of deployed decision models, services, and automations.
resources.businessGoals: Monitor and optimize decision system performance through comprehensive analytics
resources.prompt: Create a decision performance dashboard that tracks: (1) Decision volume and throughput by service/model, (2) Response times and SLA compliance metrics, (3) Decision accuracy and model drift indicators, (4) Straight-through processing rates by automation, (5) Exception handling and escalation patterns, (6) Business outcome metrics (approval rates, revenue impact), (7) System health and availability status, and (8) Regulatory compliance monitoring. Include drill-down capabilities and automated alerting. Reference existing resources: credit-scoring-service-001, loan-automation-001, fraud-detection-ml-001, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for monitoring requirements and alert thresholds.

resources.name: Customer Experience KPI Dashboard Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating a customer experience dashboard that tracks metrics across all automated decision touchpoints.
resources.businessGoals: Optimize customer experience through comprehensive journey monitoring and analytics
resources.prompt: Build a customer experience dashboard that monitors: (1) End-to-end journey completion rates by automation, (2) Customer satisfaction scores at each decision point, (3) Abandonment rates and friction indicators, (4) Resolution times for customer service interactions, (5) Personalization effectiveness and engagement metrics, (6) Channel preference patterns and optimization opportunities, (7) Complaint categories related to automated decisions, and (8) Competitive benchmarking metrics. Include customer segment analysis and predictive insights. Reference existing automations: customer-onboarding-automation-001, pricing-service-001, recommendation-engine-001, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for customer experience standards and satisfaction targets.

resources.name: Risk and Compliance Monitoring Dashboard Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating a risk monitoring dashboard that tracks compliance and risk metrics across all decision services and policies.
resources.businessGoals: Ensure comprehensive risk management and regulatory compliance across all decision systems
resources.prompt: Create a risk and compliance dashboard that tracks: (1) Regulatory compliance scores by jurisdiction and requirement, (2) Model bias detection and fairness metrics across demographics, (3) Fraud detection rates and false positive trends, (4) Policy violation incidents and resolution status, (5) Data privacy compliance and consent management, (6) Operational risk indicators and mitigation status, (7) Audit trail completeness and accessibility, and (8) Third-party vendor compliance and performance. Include automated compliance reporting and risk scoring. Reference existing policies: data-privacy-policy-001, anti-fraud-policy-001, and existing services: fraud-detection-service-001, compliance-monitoring-service-001, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for risk tolerance levels and compliance requirements.

resources.name: AI Ethics and Governance Policy Creation Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating comprehensive AI ethics and governance policies for responsible AI deployment in decision systems.
resources.businessGoals: Establish responsible AI practices and maintain stakeholder trust through comprehensive governance
resources.prompt: Create an AI ethics and governance policy framework that covers: (1) Fairness and bias prevention requirements for all ML models, (2) Transparency and explainability standards for automated decisions, (3) Data privacy and consent management protocols, (4) Model validation and testing procedures, (5) Human oversight and intervention requirements, (6) Customer rights and appeals processes, (7) Vendor AI governance and due diligence, (8) Incident response and remediation procedures, and (9) Regular ethics review and audit schedules. Include role definitions and accountability structures. Reference existing frameworks: EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for organizational values and risk tolerance.

resources.name: Data Governance and Quality Policy Prompt
resources.description: Prompt for creating data governance policies that ensure data quality, lineage, and compliance across all decision systems.
resources.businessGoals: Ensure high-quality, compliant data foundation for reliable decision making
resources.prompt: Develop a data governance policy that establishes: (1) Data quality standards and measurement criteria, (2) Data lineage tracking and documentation requirements, (3) Master data management and stewardship roles, (4) Data access controls and privacy protection measures, (5) Data retention and archival policies, (6) Cross-system data integration standards, (7) Data validation and cleansing procedures, (8) Incident response for data quality issues, and (9) Regular data governance audits and reviews. Include data classification schemes and handling requirements. Reference existing regulations: HIPAA, GDPR, and reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for data classification and security requirements.

resources.name: Extract Decision Models from Policy Document
resources.description: Meta prompt for analyzing policy documents to identify and extract all embedded decision models, business rules, and decision logic that can be automated.
resources.businessGoals: Accelerate decision model development by extracting actionable logic from existing policy documents
resources.prompt: Analyze the provided policy document and extract all decision models, business rules, and automated decision logic. For each identified component: (1) Extract the decision criteria and conditions, (2) Identify input data requirements and validation rules, (3) Map decision outcomes and actions, (4) Determine automation potential and complexity, (5) Identify dependencies on other policies or systems, (6) Note compliance and regulatory requirements, (7) Suggest implementation approach (decision model vs rule model vs ML model), and (8) Provide priority ranking based on business impact. Reference the source policy document sections and ensure traceability. Output as structured list with implementation recommendations for each extracted component.

resources.name: Extract Decision Services from Policy Framework
resources.description: Meta prompt for analyzing policy frameworks to identify all potential decision services, API endpoints, and automated workflows that can be implemented.
resources.businessGoals: Identify and design decision services based on existing policy frameworks for rapid implementation
resources.prompt: Analyze the policy framework to identify all potential decision services and automated workflows. For each service: (1) Define service purpose and business function, (2) Identify required input parameters and data sources, (3) Map decision logic and processing steps, (4) Define output format and response structure, (5) Determine integration points with existing systems, (6) Identify security and authorization requirements, (7) Note performance and SLA requirements, (8) Design API endpoints and data contracts, and (9) Map dependencies on other services or policies. Include error handling scenarios and fallback procedures. Output as service catalog with technical specifications and implementation priorities.

resources.name: Extract Decision Automations from Process Documentation
resources.description: Meta prompt for analyzing process documentation and policy manuals to identify end-to-end workflows that can be automated using decision intelligence.
resources.businessGoals: Transform manual processes into automated workflows by extracting decision logic from existing documentation
resources.prompt: Analyze the process documentation to identify complete workflows suitable for decision automation. For each workflow: (1) Map the end-to-end process from trigger to completion, (2) Identify all decision points and approval gates, (3) Extract business rules and validation logic, (4) Determine data inputs and system integrations required, (5) Identify manual steps that can be automated, (6) Map exception handling and escalation procedures, (7) Define success criteria and completion conditions, (8) Estimate automation complexity and effort, and (9) Identify required governance and audit controls. Include process flow diagrams and automation architecture recommendations. Reference **@YOUR_POLICY** for specific organizational procedures and approval hierarchies.

resources.name: Update Decision Model with New Policy Requirements
resources.description: Meta prompt for updating existing decision models to incorporate new policy requirements, regulatory changes, or business rule modifications.
resources.businessGoals: Maintain decision model currency and compliance through systematic policy integration
resources.prompt: Update the specified decision model to incorporate new policy requirements. Analysis steps: (1) Compare existing model logic with new policy requirements, (2) Identify conflicts and required changes to decision rules, (3) Assess impact on existing decision flows and outcomes, (4) Design modification approach to maintain backward compatibility, (5) Update input validation and data requirements, (6) Modify decision criteria and thresholds as needed, (7) Update output formats and explanations, (8) Test updated model against historical cases, and (9) Create migration plan and rollback procedures. Document all changes with policy traceability and impact assessment. Reference existing model: **[MODEL_ID]** and new policy: **@YOUR_POLICY**.

resources.name: Deploy Decision Service with Blue-Green Strategy
resources.description: Meta prompt for deploying updated decision services using blue-green deployment strategy with comprehensive testing and rollback capabilities.
resources.businessGoals: Enable safe and reliable deployment of decision service updates with minimal risk and rapid recovery
resources.prompt: Deploy the updated decision service using blue-green deployment strategy. Deployment plan: (1) Prepare green environment with updated service version, (2) Configure load balancer and traffic routing, (3) Execute comprehensive pre-deployment testing (unit, integration, performance), (4) Deploy canary release with 5% traffic allocation, (5) Monitor key metrics (response time, error rate, business outcomes), (6) Gradually increase traffic allocation (20%, 50%, 100%), (7) Validate decision accuracy against baseline, (8) Monitor for 24 hours with automated rollback triggers, and (9) Decommission blue environment after validation. Include monitoring dashboards, alert configurations, and emergency procedures. Reference service: **[SERVICE_ID]** and monitoring requirements: **@YOUR_POLICY**.

resources.name: Batch Update ML Models with New Training Data
resources.description: Meta prompt for systematically updating multiple ML models with new training data while maintaining model performance and governance standards.
resources.businessGoals: Systematically update ML models to maintain accuracy and relevance with automated governance controls
resources.prompt: Execute batch update of ML models with new training data and validation procedures. Update process: (1) Validate new training data quality and completeness, (2) Check for data drift and distribution changes, (3) Retrain models using updated datasets, (4) Compare new model performance against current baselines, (5) Execute bias testing and fairness validation, (6) Validate model explanations and interpretability, (7) Test integration with existing decision services, (8) Stage models in testing environment with production data replay, (9) Deploy models with A/B testing framework, and (10) Monitor model performance and business impact. Include model lineage tracking, audit trails, and rollback procedures. Reference model registry and governance policies: **@YOUR_POLICY**.

resources.name: Audit Decision Intelligence Resource Portfolio
resources.description: Meta prompt for conducting comprehensive audits of all decision intelligence resources to assess performance, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
resources.businessGoals: Ensure optimal performance and compliance across all decision intelligence resources
resources.prompt: Conduct comprehensive audit of decision intelligence resource portfolio. Audit framework: (1) Inventory all decision models, services, automations, and supporting resources, (2) Assess utilization rates and business value delivery, (3) Evaluate performance against defined KPIs and SLAs, (4) Review compliance with governance policies and regulatory requirements, (5) Analyze resource dependencies and integration health, (6) Identify redundancies and consolidation opportunities, (7) Assess security posture and access controls, (8) Review disaster recovery and business continuity readiness, (9) Evaluate vendor relationships and third-party risks, and (10) Generate optimization recommendations with priority ranking. Include risk assessment, cost-benefit analysis, and implementation roadmap. Reference existing resources and policies: **@YOUR_POLICY**.

resources.name: Create Resource Retirement and Migration Plan
resources.description: Meta prompt for creating systematic plans to retire legacy decision resources and migrate to new implementations with minimal business disruption.
resources.businessGoals: Safely retire legacy systems while migrating to modern decision intelligence platforms
resources.prompt: Create comprehensive retirement and migration plan for legacy decision resources. Migration strategy: (1) Analyze current resource usage patterns and business dependencies, (2) Map legacy functionality to new platform capabilities, (3) Design data migration strategy with validation checkpoints, (4) Create parallel processing approach for validation, (5) Develop user training and change management plan, (6) Design gradual traffic shifting with monitoring, (7) Create rollback procedures and contingency plans, (8) Plan for legacy system decomissioning and data archival, (9) Develop post-migration validation and optimization plan, and (10) Document lessons learned and best practices. Include timeline, resource allocation, risk mitigation strategies, and success criteria. Reference legacy systems and target architecture: **@YOUR_POLICY**.

resources.name: Create Policy Draft from Business Requirements
resources.description: Meta prompt for creating comprehensive policy drafts based on business requirements, regulatory guidelines, and industry best practices.
resources.businessGoals: Accelerate policy creation while ensuring comprehensive coverage and regulatory compliance
resources.prompt: Create comprehensive policy draft based on provided business requirements and regulatory context. Policy development framework: (1) Analyze business requirements and objectives, (2) Research applicable regulatory requirements and industry standards, (3) Define policy scope, applicability, and stakeholder roles, (4) Establish governance structure and decision-making authority, (5) Create detailed procedures and implementation guidelines, (6) Define compliance monitoring and audit requirements, (7) Establish violation consequences and remediation procedures, (8) Create training and communication requirements, (9) Design review and update procedures, and (10) Include implementation timeline and success metrics. Structure as formal policy document with clear sections, definitions, and cross-references. Reference regulatory frameworks and organizational standards: **@YOUR_POLICY**.

resources.name: Generate Policy from Existing Decision Models
resources.description: Meta prompt for reverse-engineering policy documents from existing decision models and business rules to formalize implicit policies.
resources.businessGoals: Formalize implicit business policies by extracting and documenting decision logic from existing systems
resources.prompt: Generate formal policy documentation from existing decision models and business rules. Policy extraction process: (1) Analyze decision model logic and rule sets, (2) Identify implicit business policies and decision criteria, (3) Extract approval thresholds and authority levels, (4) Document exception handling and escalation procedures, (5) Identify compliance requirements embedded in logic, (6) Map stakeholder roles and responsibilities, (7) Create policy statements from decision rules, (8) Establish governance framework for policy maintenance, (9) Design audit trail and monitoring requirements, and (10) Create formal policy document structure with proper versioning. Include policy rationale, business impact assessment, and implementation guidelines. Reference existing models: **[MODEL_IDS]** and organizational context: **@YOUR_POLICY**.

resources.name: Create Compliance Policy from Regulatory Requirements
resources.description: Meta prompt for creating detailed compliance policies by analyzing regulatory requirements and translating them into actionable organizational policies.
resources.businessGoals: Ensure comprehensive regulatory compliance through clear, actionable organizational policies
resources.prompt: Create detailed compliance policy from regulatory requirements and mandates. Policy development approach: (1) Analyze regulatory text and extract specific requirements, (2) Map requirements to organizational processes and systems, (3) Translate regulatory language into clear business procedures, (4) Define roles, responsibilities, and accountability structures, (5) Establish monitoring and reporting requirements, (6) Create violation detection and remediation procedures, (7) Design training and awareness programs, (8) Establish regular review and update cycles, (9) Create implementation checklist and timeline, and (10) Design compliance measurement and audit framework. Include regulatory reference mapping, risk assessment, and cost-benefit analysis. Reference regulatory documents and organizational context: **@YOUR_POLICY**.

resources.name: Credit Portfolio Risk Dashboard
resources.description: Interactive dashboard for monitoring credit portfolio performance with real-time risk metrics, concentration analysis, and early warning indicators. Includes drill-down capabilities and automated alerts.
resources.businessGoals: Provide comprehensive portfolio oversight with proactive risk identification and management

resources.name: Auto Insurance Claims Processing Model
resources.description: Automated decision model for processing auto insurance claims including damage assessment, liability determination, and settlement calculations. Integrates with repair network and supports subrogation workflows.
